name: HangingTagCard
job: A product or service card hung from a string that swings with real pendulum physics when touched
visitor_action: hover or drag the tag to swing it; tap on touch; arrow keys push it when focused, Escape settles it
mobile: tap swings once, no drag required
motion: pendulum swing with damped spring settle, shadow follows angle (reduced-motion: static slightly tilted tag)
art_direction: Kraft atelier: unbleached kraft stock with reinforced eyelet, twine, ink-stamp type in forest green, soft cast shadow on wall
provenance: original, built from a concept description
notes: Render and craft gates skipped per Guy 2026-11-23; unreviewed visually. Fonts are self-hosted woff2 files in the component folder. 2026-11-23: quality redo 2 (Sonnet 5.5, QA fail) 2026-11-23: composition round 2 (lit plaster wall fills frame, tag ~68% of frame height, thick twisted cord tied off at an iron nail, kraft with relief and fibre, paper-reinforced brass eyelet, heavier shadow; checked in headless Chrome at 1280 only, shot.sh not run)
